How it works

Remote design,
seamlessly delivered.

01
Discovery Call
30–45 min · Video call

We discuss your space, style and budget. You show Sam your home live on video. By the end, the vision is clear.

02
Documentation
Photos · Video · Floor plan

You send photos, a video walkthrough and measurements. Sam provides a precise guide so you know exactly what to capture.

03
Design & Renders
2–4 weeks · Full package

Sam develops the complete design — floor plans, moodboards, 3D renders and a curated shopping list with direct links.

04
Deliver & Implement
Presentation · Revisions · Support

Sam presents on video. After revisions, you receive your complete package — ready to implement at your own pace.
